name: Sikkim-Darjeeling Grand Tour
description: A grand tour covering the best of Sikkim and Darjeeling — from the vibrant capital Gangtok to the scenic viewpoints of Pelling and the colonial charm of Darjeeling with its tea gardens and Kanchenjunga sunrise.
route: Bagdogra → Kalimpong → Gangtok → Tsomgo Lake → Pelling → Darjeeling → Bagdogra
highlights: Visit Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir
Scenic Pelling with Skywalk and Pemayangtse Monastery
Discover stunning Darjeeling with Tiger Hill sunrise
Tea garden visits and toy train experience

itinerary.title: Arrival & Transfer to Kalimpong
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Bagdogra Airport/NJP. Drive to Kalimpong. Visit Durpin Dara, Delo View Point, and Flower Market. Overnight in Kalimpong.

itinerary.title: Kalimpong to Gangtok
itinerary.desc: Drive to Gangtok via Teesta River. Visit Rumtek Monastery and Enchey Monastery. Evening stroll on MG Marg. Overnight in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Excursion to Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir
itinerary.desc: Drive to Tsomgo Lake at 12,400 ft. Visit Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir. Return to Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Local Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Visit Tashi Viewpoint, Ganesh Tok, Institute of Tibetology, Do-drul Chorten, and Ban Jhakri Waterfalls. Overnight in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok to Pelling via Ravangla
itinerary.desc: Drive to Pelling via Ravangla. Visit Buddha Park. Check in at Pelling hotel. Evening at leisure with mountain views.

itinerary.title: Pelling Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Visit Pemayangtse Monastery, Rabdentse Ruins, Khecheopalri Lake, Rimbi Waterfalls, and Pelling Skywalk. Overnight in Pelling.

itinerary.title: Pelling to Darjeeling
itinerary.desc: Drive to Darjeeling. Visit Tiger Hill for sunrise (next morning), explore the Mall, Batasia Loop, and Himalayan Mountaineering Institute.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, transfer to NJP/Bagdogra for onward journey.

inclusions: Private vehicle for transfers and sightseeing
Toll, parking, permits, and driver allowances
exclusions: Any additional cost due to natural or unforeseen circumstances
